demos.summary: 6am at Arpoador looks lovely for a swim: calm seas, warm water, and even potential whale sightings to spot from the safety of the shallows.
Be cautious: water is warm but the high jellyfish risk makes this a less than ideal time for a swim.
Given the high wind speed and larger wave height, it's a tough call for swimming. Might want to check conditions again tomorrow evening.

signature.instructions:
Explain, in one or two friendly sentences, why this hour/beach is (or isn't) a good time
for open-water swimming tomorrow — for someone who already trusts the numbers (they're shown
separately) and just wants the human-readable takeaway. Always call out jellyfish risk when
it's Moderate or High. Mention whale sighting likelihood only when it's Moderate or High —
it's a nice-to-know, not a safety factor, so don't let it crowd out the jellyfish/conditions
takeaway. Never invent conditions not given.

fields.description: Low, Moderate, or High — informational only, never affects the score
1-2 sentences, plain language, no bullet points
